topic: Loki, a giant prince, repeatedly begged Rocks D. Xebec to join his crew as a teenager, got refused every time, and still idolizes him, a side point of Blackbeard's crew-building story
title: The Giant Prince Who Begged To Join Rocks' Crew
description: Before Blackbeard, Rocks D. Xebec had a devoted fan who never stopped asking to sail with him. Loki, the young giant prince of Elbaph, kept begging to join the Rocks Pirates and got turned down every time. He still says he was born in the wrong era.
comment: Is Blackbeard copying Rocks on purpose, or is he just doing what powerful pirates always do?

lines.text: A giant prince begged to join Rocks D. Xebec's crew, again and again.

shot.search: Loki young giant prince Rocks Xebec
shot.fallback: young giant prince pleading with a pirate captain

lines.text: Loki was just fifteen when he first met the pirate who became his idol.

shot.fallback: teenage giant looking up at a legendary captain

lines.text: Rocks said no every time, because he didn't want a child on his ship.

shot.search: Rocks D. Xebec captain refuses Loki
shot.fallback: stern pirate captain shaking his head

lines.text: Loki never stopped admiring him. He still says he was born in the wrong era.

shot.search: Loki admires Rocks Xebec wrong era
shot.fallback: wistful giant gazing at the sea

lines.text: People will say he was just a starstruck kid. Fair, but he kept asking anyway.

shot.fallback: eager young giant with hopeful eyes

lines.text: Now flip it to Blackbeard, whose father sent him away to God Valley for safety.

shot.search: Rocks Xebec family God Valley Teach
shot.fallback: distant island at dusk with a small boat

lines.text: Here's my read: Teach never stood beside his father, so he copied the crew instead.

shot.search: Marshall D. Teach Blackbeard crew Rocks Xebec
shot.fallback: dark pirate studying an old captain's flag

lines.text: Loki wanted a place on that ship. Teach built his own from the same blueprint.
That's the difference between a fan and an heir.
And that's only half of why Blackbeard still carries his father's name everywhere.

shot.fallback: pirate flagship sailing under a dark sky

lines.text: That's why the giant prince who begged to join Rocks' crew still matters.

shot.fallback: giant prince standing alone at the shore
